export.privacy: Diagnostic export may include WebRTC ICE candidate IP addresses, ports, protocols, foundations, and related network metadata because network-path diagnosis is an explicit purpose of this experiment. Cookies, browsing history, precise device location, and unrelated local-storage contents are not exported.

scheduler.interpretation: Observed library segment lifecycle; not an independent proof verdict.

webrtcConnectionBudget.note: Library defaults, not overridden by this diagnostic. A single attempt can legitimately take up to roughly the sum of the ICE gathering and connection timeouts, plus however much of the offer wait it needs, before the library itself gives up.

stallRescue.reason: zero P2P bytes received after 1000ms in P2P-only mode
